dependencies.contract: Timestamp and consume each edge once; preserve menu interception and record availability.
Only admitted actions; preserve Player wrapper previous-state, eligibility, hook and damage-reset ownership; separate eligible timers and world/UI side effects before repetition.
Preserve movement-before-action and later root-motion slot; distinct previous Player position.
Dry scene geometry only initially; floor/wall/ceiling/ledge dependencies need profile fixtures.
Player-owned queues, authored frame units, once-only marker crossings, live joint history.
Canonical extraction first; real pose, warm-up sweep history, combo increment, shield and cylinder state.
Admitted NORMAL, TARGET (parallel), FOLLOWTARGET (friendly) and slash-selected STILL modes; previous camera input yaw; held world target transform.
Canonical category/list order, target AI/reaction/cooldown/health/spawns/RNG; generation-bound proxies.
Partition Player pairs from world pairs, ordered timestamped events, authored opportunity dedup, reject unadmitted reciprocal interactions.
Separate Player candidate/leash query from world Navi/targetPriority and visual reticle work.
Single logical events; world/HUD clocks remain canonical; no duplicate sequence commands or audio mixer work.
Preserve global RNG draw opportunity/order, not one random opportunity per Player step.
NPCs, bosses, authored scripts, environment, dialogue and unrelated timers remain canonical.
Keep unextracted pose/culling/RNG/authority at old cadence and order; no global purity assumption.
Timestamped Player geometry samples; world effect lifetime stays canonical until separately specified.
Immutable committed packets, resource lifetime, no gameplay transforms from interpolation.
Platforms/riders, push/grab, moving geometry require joint temporal model.
Carry/get-item, hookshot, projectiles, bow, stick, hammer, reflection, first-person and custom geometry require separate fixtures.
Hostile blocks/parries, water, climbing, quake/distortion/cutscene/gyro modes and high-rate enemy coupling remain excluded.
